node.title: JubAp.Net Frontier Operations Role in the IMSV.org Circle
node.reading:
The research and publication policy separates custody, authorship and assessment status. Record what an institutional receiver can retain, explain and make available, with the relevant rights and limits. A public contribution, an adopted method and an independently evaluated result remain separate states.

The architectural-continuity account suggests a valuable role for the circle: retain what an operating problem taught even when it is not ready for commercial generalisation. The field question is what survives the transition from a particular team and client setting into a reusable body of knowledge. Some elements may become a framework; others may remain a bounded case or an unresolved research question. That selective process preserves intellectual continuity without implying common ownership, universal usefulness or validation by association.
node.readingSummary: The research and publication policy separates custody, authorship and assessment status.

relations: Institutional preservation can keep a capability available while leaving its contribution, recognition and legal rights as separate questions.
La custodia institucional no prueba contribución económica ni transfiere por sí misma todos los derechos legales.
Frontier engineering can feed selected artifacts into institutional stewardship, with lineage, scope and readiness retained before broader reuse.
La transferencia es selectiva. Participar en un círculo no transfiere automáticamente propiedad o derechos de todos los proyectos.
For a complementary reading, see [Research and publication policy](https://tegrity.ai/research-publication-policy/).
For a complementary reading, see [Twenty years of architectural continuity](https://jubap.net/frontier-engineering-ecosystem-awareness-architectural-continuity/).
For a complementary reading, see [JubAp.Net in the IMSV.org institutional architecture](https://jubap.net/jubap-net-role-in-imsv-org-frontier-engineering-and-operations-circle/).
La relación con el círculo de ingeniería distingue ejecución, documentación y custodia.
